the_signal.headline: RBAC breaks at agentic layer—task-based rules now replace roles
the_signal.body: Static role-based access control introduces security gaps when agents make autonomous decisions across your GTM stack. n8n's analysis shows why traditional IAM fails for multi-agent systems and why task-based authorization is becoming table stakes. If your agents touch customer data or revenue workflows, you're exposed today.

tool_drop.name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore multi-agent teams
tool_drop.what: Single orchestration layer for triage + specialist agents that maintain persistent customer context across conversations.
tool_drop.why: GTM teams running parallel agents for lead qualification, data retrieval, and customer investigation need unified memory—this removes the context handoff tax that kills conversion velocity.

thread_of_day.title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
thread_of_day.takeaway: Agents working in multi-agent teams without predefined workflows are discovering novel solutions—signals that your GTM automation shouldn't be rigid choreography but adaptive orchestration.

quote.text: Traditional access control breaks at the agentic layer—task-based rules help. Learn why static roles introduce risky security gaps and how authorization evolves for agents.
quote.source: n8n Blog: RBAC for AI Agents

whats_moving.context: RBAC failing in production multi-agent setups is pushing GTM stacks toward capability-based and task-based access models instead of static roles.
Bedrock AgentCore's single memory layer for specialist teams shows the market moving away from stateless agents toward persistent customer context across triage → execution.

whats_moving.topic: ETL vs ELT trade-offs for revenue automation
whats_moving.context: n8n's pattern guide surfacing again signals GTM teams still choosing wrong between transform-before-load (slow, certain) and load-then-transform (fast, operationally riskier).

act_on_this: Audit your agent authorization layer today—if you're using static roles for multi-agent revenue workflows, you have a compliance and security debt that will break at scale. Map which agents touch PII or financial data and move those to task-based rules this sprint.

numbers.stat: 3-specialist agent triage pattern (compute + data retrieval + investigation)
numbers.context: Teams running parallel agent lanes for different customer question types are seeing faster resolution and lower hallucination rates—this is becoming the standard GTM automation pattern.
